scenarios.description: In Section 1.2, the table contains a column named "Currency", and the document defines Index Currency as the currency specified in that column.
The document says Index Currency is specified in the "Amount" column of the table in Section 1.2, while the "Currency" column exists but is not used for that definition.
Section 1.2 has two tables, and one of them has a "Currency" column; the text does not say which table the definition uses.
The table and its "Currency" column are introduced later in the document, after the definition of Index Currency, but the definition still refers to the table in Section 1.2.
